EMPLOYEE AGREEMENT
In consideration of my employment by Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corporation and the compenation
to be paid to me asa resuit of such employment, I agree to the following terms and conditions:
As used in this AGREEMENT, the following terms shall have the meanings shown:
A.
B&W means Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corporation.
B.
CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION means information, not generally known, about B&W's pro-
cesses and products, including information relating to research, development, manufasture, purehasing,
accounting, engineering, marketing, merchandising and selling.
INVENTiONS means discoveries, improvements and ideas (whether patentable or not) relating
to any activities of B&W.
With respect to INVENTiONS made or conceived by me, either soiely or jointly with others, during (1)
my employment or (2) within one year after termination of my employment If band on CONFIDENTIAL
INFORMATION learned at B&W, I agree:
A.
To promptly and fully inform B&W in writing of such INVENTiONS.
B.
To assign to B&W, at the request of B&W, all of my rights to such INVENTlONS and to
Applications for Letters Patent and to Letters Patent granted upon such INVENTIONS in the United
States and foreign countries.
C.
To acknowledge and deliver promptly to B&W (without charge to B&W, but at the expense of
B&W) such written instruments and to do such other acts as may be necessary in the opinion of B&W
to obtain and maintain Letters Patent in the United States and foreign countries and to vest the entire
right and title thereto in B&W.
EXCEPT as required in my duties to B&W, I will never um or disciose any CONFIDENTiAL
INFORMATION.
UPON termination of my employmemt with B&W, all records of CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION,
including copies thereof in my possession, whether prepared by me or others, will be left with B&W.
I AGREE that my obligations under this AGREEMENT shall be binding upon my heirs, assigns, and
legal representatives.
I acknowledge receipt of a copy of this AGREEMENT.
THE LAW of the State of Kemtucky shall govern this AGREEMENT.
